title: Salvia miltiorrhiza ultrafine powder improves ileal barrier function and health of hens during late laying period via TLR4/NF-kappaB-mediated macrophage polarization.
authors: Meng, Chengwen; Azad, Md Abul Kalam; Lin, Wenchao; Gui, Jue; Cui, Yadong; Lan, Wei; Kong, Xiangfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹参超微粉通过TLR4/NF-kB通路改善蛋鸡肠道屏障功能，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是动物营养与肠道健康，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Declining laying performance and egg quality during the late laying period are closely associated with intestinal barrier dysfunction, chronic inflammation, and gut microbiota dysbiosis. In our previous study, dietary supplementation with 15 g/kg Salvia miltiorrhiza ultrafine powder (SMUP) exhibited the greatest improvement in laying performance and egg quality of hens during late laying period. However, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Therefore, the present study further investigate the effects of dietary SMUP on ileal morphology, barrier function, immune response, and gut microbiota, combined with in silico analyses to elucidate the potential molecular mechanisms. METHODS: A two-group feeding trial with late-laying hens was conducted to evaluate ileal histomorphology, tight junction protein expression, plasma and ileal inflammatory cytokine levels, and ileal microbial community composition through 16S rRNA sequencing. Transcriptomic data from LPS-stimulated chicken HD11 macrophages (GSE278197) were analyzed by differential expression and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) to identify macrophage polarization hub genes. Network pharmacology, molecular docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations were sequentially performed to identify the key bioactive compound of SMUP and its target protein related to intestinal immune regulation. RESULTS: Dietary SMUP (15 g/kg) reduced ileal crypt depth (CD), increased villus height/CD ratio, upregulated tight junction proteins (claudin-1, occludin, and ZO-1), and inhibited the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway by downregulating TLR4 and NF-kappaB p65 expressions (P < 0.05). Additionally, SMUP downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha, IFN-gamma, and iNOS), elevated anti-inflammatory cytokines (IL-4 and IL-10) expressions in the ileum, and increased plasma IL-10 level (P < 0.05). Dietary SMUP also modulated gut microbiota by reducing the Tenericutes abundance and enriching predicted ansamycin biosynthesis. Furthermore, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations identified tanshinone IIA as a core compound directly targeting NFKBIA (encoding IkappaBalpha), suggesting that SMUP stabilizes IkappaBalpha, thereby blocking its phosphorylation-dependent degradation and subsequent NF-kappaB nuclear translocation. Through inhibition of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway, SMUP promoted the polarization of intestinal macrophages from the pro-inflammatory M1 toward the anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype, which was consistent with the reciprocal changes in M1/M2-related gene expression. CONCLUSION: Dietary SMUP improves intestinal health of late-laying hens by strengthening the intestinal barrier, alleviating inflammation (via inhibiting the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway and promoting M2-type macrophage polarization), and modulating the gut microbiota. These improvements in intestinal health supported SMUP as a promising natural plant-derived feed additive for hens during late laying period.
abstract_zh: 背景：产蛋后期蛋鸡产蛋性能和蛋品质下降与肠道屏障功能障碍、慢性炎症及肠道菌群失调密切相关。我们前期研究发现，日粮中添加15 g/kg丹参超微粉（SMUP）对产蛋后期蛋鸡的产蛋性能和蛋品质改善效果最佳，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。因此，本研究进一步探讨日粮SMUP对回肠形态、屏障功能、免疫反应及肠道菌群的影响，并结合计算机模拟分析阐明潜在分子机制。方法：以产蛋后期蛋鸡为对象进行两组饲养试验，评估回肠组织形态学、紧密连接蛋白表达、血浆及回肠炎症细胞因子水平，并通过16S rRNA测序分析回肠微生物群落组成。对脂多糖刺激的鸡HD11巨噬细胞转录组数据（GSE278197）进行差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），以鉴定巨噬细胞极化枢纽基因。依次进行网络药理学、分子对接和100 ns分子动力学模拟，以鉴定SMUP中与肠道免疫调节相关的关键生物活性化合物及其靶蛋白。结果：日粮添加SMUP（15 g/kg）降低了回肠隐窝深度（CD），提高了绒毛高度/CD比值，上调了紧密连接蛋白（claudin-1、occludin和ZO-1），并通过下调TLR4和NF-kappaB p65表达抑制了TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路（P < 0.05）。此外，SMUP下调了回肠中促炎细胞因子（IL-1beta、IL-6、TNF-alpha、IFN-gamma和iNOS）的表达，升高了抗炎细胞因子（IL-4和IL-10）的表达，并提高了血浆IL-10水平（P < 0.05）。日粮SMUP还通过降低Tenericutes丰度并富集预测的安莎霉素生物合成途径来调节肠道菌群。进一步通过网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，鉴定出丹参酮IIA为直接靶向NFKBIA（编码IkappaBalpha）的核心化合物，提示SMUP稳定IkappaBalpha，从而阻断其磷酸化依赖性降解及随后的NF-kappaB核转位。通过抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB通路，SMUP促进肠道巨噬细胞从促炎M1表型向抗炎M2表型极化，这与M1/M2相关基因表达的相互变化一致。结论：日粮SMUP通过增强肠道屏障、缓解炎症（通过抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB通路并促进M2型巨噬细胞极化）及调节肠道菌群，改善产蛋后期蛋鸡的肠道健康。这些肠道健康的改善支持SMUP作为产蛋后期蛋鸡的一种有前景的天然植物源饲料添加剂。
